text:
Chlorine, bromine and iodine are in the same group of the Periodic Table.
Which statements about these three elements are correct?
1
Iodine is more reactive than chlorine.
2
They are diatomic covalent molecules.
3
They are all gases at room temperature.
4
Their atoms have seven electrons in their outer shell.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
